name: Crater Lake Academy Inc- Salmon Way

nadir.desc: The property consists of a single-story metal commercial building with a light gray standing-seam roof|A paved parking lot runs along the front side of the building with marked spaces and multiple vehicles|A gravel area at one end of the lot holds a yellow school bus and additional vehicles|Railroad tracks run along the rear edge of the site|Limited landscaping is present near the street entrance.

alpha.desc: The front of the building shows a long metal-sided structure with two large roll-up garage doors and four personnel doors facing the parking lot|Multiple vehicles are parked in marked spaces|A yellow school bus and a pickup truck occupy the gravel area at one end|Railroad tracks run along the rear boundary|A fenced perimeter and street access are visible at the opposite end.

bravo.desc: The left side of the building shows the short end of the metal structure with “Crater Lake Academy” signage on the wall|A window is present on this end|A paved parking lot extends along the front side of the building|Fencing and landscaping run along the street frontage|Sidewalk and street access are visible at the corner.

charlie.desc: The rear of the building shows the long rear of the metal structure with no openings visible along this side|A fence runs along the rear property line|A yellow school bus and a pickup truck are parked in the gravel area at one end|Railroad tracks run immediately behind the fence|Rooftop units are visible on the roof.

delta.desc: The right side of the building shows the opposite end with a large roll-up garage door|The paved parking lot holds multiple vehicles|A yellow school bus and stored materials sit in the gravel area near the railroad tracks|Fencing encloses the rear and side of the lot|Railroad tracks run along the rear boundary.

considerations: Vehicle access is available from Salmon Way into a paved parking lot along the front side of the building, with additional gravel staging space at one end. Multiple vehicles and a yellow school bus occupy the lot. The structure is a single-story metal commercial building with large roll-up doors and personnel doors. Railroad tracks run directly along the rear property line. Fencing encloses portions of the site. The property is located in an industrial area surrounded by warehouses, equipment yards, and open dry ground.
clarifications: Which door is the primary public or student entrance? Are the roll-up doors used for vehicle or equipment access during operating hours? Is there a designated fire lane or emergency vehicle staging area in the parking lot? Do any gates control access from Salmon Way into the lot? Is there pedestrian or vehicle access around the rear of the building, or is that side fully fenced off from the railroad tracks?
